tables.name: public.orgs
tables.comment: Organisation (coordinators and partners). Container for campaigns, action pages(widgets), users, services and contacts/supporters data

columns.name: custom_supporter_confirm
columns.comment: Route supporter confirmation via this org's cus.* queue for external/custom gdpr validation workflow

columns.name: custom_action_confirm
columns.comment: Route action confirmation via this org's cus.* queue instead of the default queue

columns.name: custom_action_deliver
columns.comment: deliver actions to the org CRM cus.* queue

columns.name: contact_schema
columns.comment: Contact data shape collected for this org (Enums.ContactSchema); decides which PII fields exist

columns.name: email_from
columns.comment: Default From address for this org's emails

columns.name: supporter_confirm
columns.comment: Require double opt-in before a supporter is treated as active

columns.name: supporter_confirm_template
columns.comment: Email template used for the supporter confirmation message

columns.name: config
columns.comment: Free-form settings, e.g. config["reminder"] configures DOI reminder emails

columns.name: high_security
columns.comment: Never store transient action fields on the supporter record; only the org holding the contact key may keep them, can break features!

columns.name: action_schema_version
columns.comment: Proca action payload format this org uses. 2 for everyone for now

columns.name: custom_event_deliver
columns.comment: deliver events to the CRM cus.* queue

columns.name: doi_thank_you
columns.comment: Only send the thank-you email when the supporter gdpr opt-in

columns.name: reply_enabled
columns.comment: Add a Reply-To header to mtt sent for this org's campaigns

columns.name: sender_rewrite
columns.comment: Rewrite the envelope sender onto the backend's sending_from domain (SRS); disable for cleaner confirmation emails

columns.name: transactional_email_backend_id
columns.comment: Backend for transactional (non-MTT) email; falls back to email_backend. Capped by services.transactional_email_budget

tables.name: public.supporters
tables.comment: One submission by a person. Never updated: repeat submissions create new rows linked by fingerprint. No durable PII here - the email/name/address copies are transient, kept while the action is being processed and cleared at delivery; durable PII lives in contacts

columns.name: fingerprint
columns.comment: Hash of the person's identifying data; rows sharing a fingerprint are the same person

columns.name: first_name
columns.comment: Kept for email personalisation; by default it survives delivery and is only cleared for high_security orgs. Durable PII lives in contacts

columns.name: email
columns.comment: Transient: used to send confirmation and thank-you email during processing, cleared at delivery (kept for MTT campaigns, which email supporters later). Durable PII lives in contacts

columns.name: processing_status
columns.comment: State: 0 new, 1 confirming (awaiting double opt-in or moderation), 2 rejected (not counted), 3 accepted (valid, counted). Enums.SupporterProcessingStatus

columns.name: area
columns.comment: Area recorded on the action; kept because statistics need it and it is not PII

columns.name: email_status
columns.comment: Deliverability and opt-in state, shared by all orgs holding this supporter: 0 none (unknown), 1 double_opt_in (consented), 2 bounce, 3 blocked, 4 spam, 5 unsub, 6 inactive (do not contact), 7 active. Enums.EmailStatus

columns.name: email_status_changed
columns.comment: When email_status last changed; decides whether a status event is emitted

columns.name: last_name
columns.comment: Transient: cleared at delivery (kept for MTT campaigns, which need names to send later). Durable PII lives in contacts

columns.name: address
columns.comment: Transient: cleared at delivery (kept for MTT campaigns, which need it to send later). Durable PII lives in contacts

columns.name: dupe_rank
columns.comment: 0 for the first submission by this person on the page, N for the Nth duplicate

indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX supporters_pkey ON public.supporters USING btree (id)

indexes.def: CREATE INDEX supporters_campaign_id_index ON public.supporters USING btree (campaign_id)

indexes.name: supporters_action_page_id_index

indexes.name: supporters_processing_status_index
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX supporters_processing_status_index ON public.supporters USING btree (processing_status)

indexes.name: supporters_dupe_rank_index

columns.comment: Encrypted personal data; only a holder of the matching key can decrypt it

columns.name: communication_consent

columns.name: communication_scopes

columns.name: delivery_consent
